subject: Novapulse go‑live phases, owner roster & contingency cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramirez <elena@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novapulse go‑live phases, owner roster & contingency cadence

Hi Elena — great meeting this morning. Per our discussion I put together a concise MAP + phased go‑live plan so everyone has clear milestones, owners, and the contingency cadence if anything slips. The attached workbook has two sheets: Phase gates & owners, and a sprint‑by‑sprint timeline. Topline items below so we can move quickly: 

Objectives (vetted with your team):
- RAMP TO PROD: get inference endpoints into production handling baseline traffic (10 req/s) with < 300ms median latency.
- DATA PATH: ensure logs and audit exports flow to your S3 staging bucket for PII redaction.
- ROLLOUT: staged rollout by dataset + traffic slice; canary -> 25% -> 100%.

Key milestones / owners (high level):
- Phase 0 (Prep): API keys, VPC peering, & SOC2 evidence exchange — Owner: Elena / Novapulse PM; Redwood SME: Marissa Cole — target: 2026-06-18
- Phase 1 (Dev Integration): Auth + test harness + prefix caching test — Owner: Novapulse backend lead; Redwood technical owner: Ben Carter — target: 2026-06-30
- Phase 2 (Canary): Canary traffic (10% slice), telemetry verification, rollback playbook validation — Owner: Soojin Lee (Redwood RTE) / Novapulse SRE — target: 2026-07-08
- Phase 3 (Full Cutover): 100% traffic, post-cutover validation, handoff to CS Ops — Owner: Hannah Schmitt / Novapulse Ops — target: 2026-07-15

Contingency cadence (if a gate fails):
1) Immediate rollback to previous model variant + notify stakeholders (15m SLA)
2) Run incident bridge for triage (30m) — RTE + Novapulse SRE
3) Postmortem + plan to re-run canary in 72 hours

Asks for Novapulse this week:
- Confirm Phase 0 owners + S3 bucket details (reply inline)
- Add your backend lead to the Drive folder linked in the attachment

I attached Novapulse_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (high level) and exported a printable Implementation_Timeline_SprintPlan.pdf. If this looks good I'll convert the MAP to a mutual action checklist and share editing rights.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai
(415) 555‑0122

From: Elena Ramirez <elena@novapulse.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novapulse Implementation Team <impl-team@novapulse.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novapulse go‑live phases, owner roster & contingency cadence

Thanks, Hannah — this is exactly the level of clarity we needed. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Phase 0 owner: I'll own API key exchange + S3 details; Novapulse backend lead (Jae Park) will be added to the Drive tonight.
- Phase 1: our test harness is ready; target to run smoke tests starting 2026-06-22.
- Canary slice: can we shorten the canary window to 48 hours if telemetry looks clean?

One concern: our security/compliance team asked whether Redwood can provide a redacted audit log sample before Phase 1. If you can surface that artifact (or a sanitized export), we can speed the SOC review.

I'll loop Jae and our SRE in the next reply.

—
Elena Ramirez
VP Product & Ops, Novapulse AI
elena@novapulse.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T20:11:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Novapulse go‑live phases, owner roster & contingency cadence

Team — forwarding Novapulse's reply. Action items for us: 

1) Marissa — can you prepare a redacted audit log sample (similar to the sample we used for Orion) and place it in the Drive folder? Novapulse security wants that before Phase 1. Target EOD 6/10.
2) Ben — confirm that prefix/KV caching test can be run on 6/22 and share a short test plan (1‑page) that Jae can run.
3) Soojin — update the MAP with a 48‑hour canary option and draft the rollback triggers (SLA thresholds: error rate > 2% or latency degradation > 40% over baseline).

Note: I'll hold off on converting to an editable mutual action checklist until we have the redacted audit log and Ben's test plan. If anyone sees risk to the dates above, flag now.

Thanks — Hannah

On Mon, Jun 8, 2026 at 3:12 PM Elena Ramirez <elena@novapulse.ai> wrote: > (quoted original)

Date: 2026-06-09T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novapulse go‑live phases, owner roster & contingency cadence

Quick update — Ben here. Confirmed: prefix caching smoke tests are green on our stage infra and we can slot Novapulse for 2026-06-22. I'll attach the 1‑page test plan to the Drive folder and ping Jae. Test plan highlights: 
- endpoint: /v1/generate (test harness)
- sample payloads: 6 templates (low, med, high token lengths)
- success criteria: median latency < 350ms, 95th < 650ms, no model errors in 10k tokens

I'll post the test plan link by EOD.

—
Ben Carter
Technical Lead, Redwood Inference Ops
ben@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-10T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novapulse go‑live phases, owner roster & contingency cadence

Thanks all — I updated the MAP with the 48‑hour canary option and added explicit rollback triggers in the contingency section (error rate threshold, latency regression, and degradation of accuracy on our validation prompts). Quick notes: 

- Canary gating: automatic fallback to the pinned fallback variant is enabled; runbook attached in the Drive (Runbook_Canary_Rollback.md).
- If canary fails, we will: 1) revert traffic routing, 2) open bridge, 3) run forensic logs.
- Recommend a short ops rehearsal on 2026-07-06 (30min dry run).

Elena — can you confirm Jae is available for the rehearsal window? If yes I'll add calendar invites and a short checklist for the dry run.

Soojin Lee
Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
